build.summary: Every replication rewrites the whole R-row accumulator with st_matrix(), whose cost is quadratic in R, so large reps()/permreps()/permexact runs slow down cubically

Apply the same change to the per-replication write-backs in wooldid_bootwrow, wooldid_bootwrowx and wooldid_bootcells. The A/B output was bitwise identical on the permute att leg. For the author, on card m277: print the caution only when att_i, att_it or att_itime is in the run (pass a flag into wooldid_bootrun, or print the caution from the shell, where the estimand list is in scope). ruling.summary: The caution does print under a strictly finer cluster. On dta_binary those contrasts are usable, so there it is noise. But on round 1's own fixture the finer-cluster pairwise se is degenerate (3.7e-09), so the proposed wdb_nest gate would silence the caution on a degenerate run. Gate on the realized degeneracy instead.
ruling.proposed_change: Do not gate on wdb_nest. Key m236 on the analytic path's pairwise degeneracy detection, as D4 (189af00) did for permute(); no number moves. The caution's condition ('where cluster() sits at or above the i level') and remedy ('a cluster() finer than i') did not hold on mkpan cfine; that text is the author's, on card m236. The card's note ('every contrast was studentized cleanly') should also be corrected.

ruling.summary: Measured: permtci's pooled interval equals the table interval of permtstat permabsp on the same draws, so permtci adds no number that permtstat permabsp lacks. Retiring it is a design call the author has not ruled on.

ruling.summary: Both refusals still happen. After a failed call, a good wooldid store restored with estimates restore will not replay. On a structurally-zero clustered VCE the collapse flips which main-table SEs are identified even on a run with no subgroups(), so guide 258/697's 'Non-subgroup runs are not exposed' is false; the design is hopeless and both arms say so.
nothing.proposed_change: Qualify the guide sentence in 258 and 697: non-subgroup runs are not exposed through a margins name read; where a variance is exactly zero by construction, whether its residue reads as a tiny positive SE or as not identified can change with the collapse, as with any change in summation order (documentation only). A relative floor on the identification test would remove the flip but moves reported SEs, and belongs to the author.

unconditionalse scales the whole linearized variance by regress's (N-1)/(N-K), with K counting every cell and i dummy
nothing.proposed_change: The author decides. (a) Keep it, and say in the help that unconditionalse carries regress's small-sample factor with every cell and i dummy counted, which can be large when cells are small. (b) Rescale the unconditional V by (N-K)/(N-1), optionally times (N-1)/(N-K_hdfe) to match the default path's convention. On this design that brings the SE to .0731-.0873, against a bootstrap .0742.
